summary: Develop your ability to lead cross-departmental projects with our specialized training. Gain valuable skills to drive collaboration and achieve team goals.
lede: Cross-departmental initiative leadership helps professionals coordinate people and work across functions toward shared goals. It is for program managers, operations leaders and other professionals responsible for initiatives that depend on cooperation across departments, including when they have limited authority over participating teams. Learners practice setting governance and accountability, aligning goals and performance measures, and coordinating stakeholders, resources and workflows using methods such as RACI, OKRs and Kanban.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with delivering results that require the active cooperation of multiple business units and functional teams.
modules: Foundations of Cross-Functional Leadership and Silo Theory
Governance Frameworks and the RACI Accountability Matrix
Strategic Alignment through OKRs and Cascading Goals
Resource Negotiation and Interest-Based Conflict Resolution
Change Management and the ADKAR Implementation Model
Agile and Lean Execution in Cross-Functional Teams
Digital Tools and AI-Enhanced Collaborative Workflows
Measuring Impact and Cross-Functional KPI Dashboards
Executive Reporting and Sustaining Strategic Momentum
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a management or project leadership role. Familiarity with basic project management concepts is recommended. No specific software prerequisites are required, though access to a laptop for digital exercises is necessary.
